meta.title: The Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
meta.enabling_act: Legal Metrology Act, 2009 (1 of 2010), s.52(1) read with s.52(2)(j) and (q)
meta.source: Department of Consumer Affairs consolidated PDF (with all amendments as on 24.12.2024)

condition_dsl.description: Conditions are JSON trees. Leaf: {field, op, value}. Combinators: all, any, not.

status_notes: Rule 5 (standard pack sizes) and the Second Schedule are OMITTED w.e.f. 01-01-2024 (GSR 779(E) as extended up to GSR 714(E)). Do not validate standard pack sizes.
Rule 33(2) is omitted. Rule 3(1) text as substituted by GSR 629(E) (w.e.f. 01-01-2018) is used.
Struck-through / superseded text in the PDF (old Table I and II of rule 7, old rule 19(5), old rule 20, old rule 32(1)-(3)) is NOT included.

package.net_quantity_unit: string (g, kg, ml, l, cm, m, dm2, m2, cm3, dm3, m3, number, unit, piece, pair, set)

applies_unless_any.description: Packages containing more than 25 kg or 25 litre
Cement, fertilizer and agricultural farm produce sold in bags above 50 kg
Packaged commodities meant for industrial or institutional consumers (package must carry declaration 'not for retail sale')

rule_26_exemptions.description: Nothing in these rules applies to a package if any of the following is true

exemptions.description: Net weight/measure is 10 g or 10 ml or less (if sold by weight or measure)
Fast food items packed by restaurant or hotel and the like
Scheduled and non-scheduled formulations covered under the Drugs (Price Control) Order, 2013
Thread sold in coil to handloom weavers
Garment or hosiery sold loose/open so consumer can inspect (finished products only), provided it bears the listed details

conditional_requirements.note: plus country of origin/manufacture if imported

conditional_requirements.then: same information must be displayed on the e-commerce website

exemptions.inserted_by: GSR 648(E) dated 22-08-2022 w.e.f. 01-01-2023; (iii) substituted by GSR 722(E) dated 06-10-2023

exemptions.description: Loose commodities ordered through e-commerce where the consumer is aware of the ordered commodity, its type and quantity, provided information below is borne

conditional_requirements.note: plus country of origin/manufacture if imported

omitted: LM-26-d (agricultural farm produce above 50 kg) omitted w.e.f. 01-01-2018

definitions.consumer: As in s.2(7) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019
definitions.dealer: Person/firm that buys, sells, supplies or distributes packaged commodities (cash/deferred/commission), incl. commission agent; excludes a manufacturer selling to a non-dealer
definitions.industrial_consumer: Consumer who buys packaged commodities directly from manufacturer/importer/wholesale dealer for use by that industry; package bears 'not for retail sale'
definitions.institutional_consumer: Institution that buys packages bearing 'not for retail sale' directly from manufacturer/importer/wholesale dealer for its own use and not for commercial or trade purposes
definitions.e_commerce: Buying and selling of goods and services including digital products over digital and electronic network
definitions.e_commerce_entity: Company (Companies Act 1956/2013), foreign company (s.2(42)), or office/branch/agency in India owned/controlled by a non-resident, conducting e-commerce
definitions.marketplace_model_of_ecommerce: IT platform provided by an e-commerce entity as a facilitator between buyer and seller
definitions.lot: (i) stored packages: total number stored; (ii) packages on/at end of packing line: maximum hourly output
definitions.manufacturer: Produces/makes the commodity, or puts (or causes to be put) a mark on a package claiming that the commodity was made by that person
definitions.maximum_permissible_error: Error in deficiency not exceeding limits in the First Schedule
definitions.net_quantity: Quantity by weight, measure or number of the commodity in the package, excluding packaging/wrapper
definitions.packer: Person/firm that pre-packs a commodity in units suitable for sale (wholesale or retail)
definitions.principal_display_panel: Total surface area of the package where required information is given: (i) all grouped in one place, or (ii) pre-printed info in one place and on-line info grouped in another
definitions.retail_dealer: Dealer who directly sells packages to the consumer (incl. wholesale dealer making direct sale)
definitions.retail_package: Package intended for retail sale to the ultimate consumer for consumption, incl. imported packages; for retail food package, FSS Act definition applies
definitions.combination_package: Retail package with two or more individual packages/pieces of DISSIMILAR commodities (e.g. spoons, forks, cups, napkins)
definitions.group_package: Retail package with two or more individual packages/pieces of SIMILAR but NOT identical commodities (e.g. assorted biscuits, sponges of different sizes)
definitions.multi_piece_package: Package with two or more individually packaged/labelled pieces of the SAME commodity of IDENTICAL quantity (e.g. 5 soap cakes of 20 g each, total 100 g). FSS Act applies for food.
definitions.retail_sale: Sale, distribution or delivery through retail shops, agencies or other instrumentalities for consumption
definitions.retail_sale_price: Maximum price at which the commodity in packaged form may be sold to the consumer, inclusive of all taxes
definitions.wholesale_dealer: Dealer who does not sell directly to consumers but through one or more intermediaries
definitions.wholesale_package: (i) a package of retail packages meant for an intermediary, not a single consumer; or (ii) bulk commodity sold to an intermediary for resale in smaller quantities; or (iii) ten or more retail packages, provided retail packages are labelled as required

rules.title: Required declarations must be on the package or a securely affixed label
rules.description: No person shall pre-pack, or cause or permit pre-packing of, any commodity for sale/distribution/delivery unless the package bears (or a securely affixed label bears) all declarations required under the Rules.
rules.notes: Packages without RSP inside the manufacturer's premises are not a violation, but every package leaving the premises must carry it.

rules.title: Promotional groupings: every package must comply with Rule 6
rules.description: When one or more retail packages are grouped and sold as a retail package on a promotional offer, every package in the group must comply with Rule 6.

rules.title: Name and address of manufacturer
rules.description: Declare name and address of the manufacturer. Name must be the actual corporate name (or business name if not incorporated). Address must be 'complete' (see LM-10-1-addr).
rules.notes: Explanation I: if a name/address appears without 'manufactured by' or 'packed by', it is presumed to be the manufacturer's. Explanation II: a brand owner shown as marketer is held responsible; where more than one name/address appears, prosecution is against the manufacturer indicated first. Explanation III: food articles - FSS Act applies instead.

rules.title: Packer name and address if manufacturer is not the packer
Importer name and address for imported packages
Electronic products: name on package; address may be via QR code
rules.description: For electronic products the name of the manufacturer/packer/importer must be on the package itself. The address and related information may be given through a QR code if the package tells consumers to scan the QR code.

rules.title: Country of origin / manufacture / assembly for imported products
Common or generic name of the commodity
Packages with more than one product: name and number/quantity of each
Electronic products: generic name may be via QR code if package says 'scan QR'
Net quantity in standard units (or number)
rules.description: Declare net quantity in terms of the standard unit of weight or measure; for commodities packed/sold by number, declare the number.

rules.title: Month and year of manufacture
rules.description: Month and year of manufacture must be mentioned on the package (words or numerals or both). The words 'or pre-packed or imported' were omitted w.e.f. 01-04-2022 (extended through 01-01-2024).
rules.notes: Food articles: FSS Act and rules apply. Cosmetics: Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945 apply. Pre-printed packaging material bearing an expected pre-pack month may be used in the next succeeding month only (Rule 6(1)(g) proviso B), not for food with best-before/use-before period of 90 days or less.

rules.title: Electronic products, spare parts and accessories: month/year anywhere on retail package, visible and legible
'Best before' / 'Use by' date, month and year
rules.description: If the commodity may become unfit for human consumption after a period, the 'best before or use by' date, month and year must be on the label. Does not apply if another law makes provision.

definitions.best_before: End of period under stated storage conditions during which the product remains fully marketable and retains specific qualities claimed; may still be safe afterwards.
definitions.use_by: End of the estimated period after which the product will not have the expected quality attributes and should not be regarded as marketable.

rules.title: Retail sale price (MRP), inclusive of all taxes, in Indian currency
rules.description: Package must declare the retail sale price and clearly indicate it is the maximum retail price inclusive of all taxes, in Indian currency.
accepted_formats_examples: Maximum Retail Price Rs. xx.xx inclusive of all taxes
MRP Rs. xx.xx incl. of all taxes
rules.notes: Alcoholic beverages/spirituous liquor: State Excise laws apply in the State of manufacture; these Rules apply only where excise law has no RSP declaration. If an essential commodity's retail price is fixed and notified under the Essential Commodities Act, 1955, that price applies.

rules.title: Dimensions where sizes of the commodity are relevant
rules.description: Declare dimensions of the commodity; if pieces differ, dimensions of each different piece.
rules.notes: Electronic products: may be via QR code if package says 'scan QR' (GSR 456(E)).

rules.title: Consumer complaint contact details
rules.description: Every package must bear name, address, telephone number and e-mail address of the person/office to contact for consumer complaints.
rules.notes: Electronic products: telephone and e-mail must be on the package itself; other related info may be via QR code (GSR 456(E)). Size of consumer care details must meet Table I (Rule 7(5)).

rules.title: No individual stickers to alter/make mandatory declarations
rules.description: Affixing individual stickers to alter or make a declaration required under these Rules is not permitted. Exception: a sticker with a revised LOWER MRP (inclusive of all taxes) may be affixed provided it does not cover the original MRP declaration.
rules.notes: Rule 6(9): a label may be affixed on imported packages to make the required declarations.

rules.title: Stickers allowed for declarations other than those required by these Rules
Additional permitted marks
rules.description: Manufacturer/packer/importer may additionally declare: (a) barcode/GTIN/QR code; (b) 'e-code' for net quantity assurance obtained per Central Government procedure; (c) logos of Government schemes (e.g. Swachh Bharat Mission) where authorised.

rules.title: Commodity with components packed in two or more units
rules.description: Declarations appear on the main package, which also carries info about the other packages, OR declarations are on each individual package with intimation on the main package. If components are sold as spare parts, all declarations must be on each package.

rules.title: Genetically modified food: 'GM' at top of principal display panel
Veg / non-veg dot on soaps, shampoos, toothpastes, cosmetics and toiletries
rules.description: Red or brown dot for products of non-vegetarian origin; green dot for products of vegetarian origin; at top of the principal display panel.

rules.title: Label may be affixed on imported packages to make declarations
E-commerce: mandatory declarations displayed on the platform
rules.description: An e-commerce entity must ensure the mandatory declarations in Rule 6(1) - EXCEPT month and year of manufacture/packing - are displayed on the digital/electronic network used for transactions. This does not exempt the declarations on pre-packaged commodities delivered to consumers.

if_all_of: entity only provides access to a communication system for information provided by manufacturer/seller/dealer/importer (or does not initiate transmission, select receiver, or select/modify the information)
entity observes due diligence as intermediary under IT Act 2000 and other Central Government guidelines
no_protection_if_any_of: entity conspired, abetted, aided or induced the unlawful act
after actual knowledge or notification by Government/agency, entity fails to expeditiously remove or disable access to the material without vitiating evidence

rules.title: Unit sale price (USP) in rupees, rounded to two decimals
rules.description: Declare USP per gram/kg, per cm/m, per ml/l, or per number/unit based on net quantity (see lookup_tables.unit_sale_price_units).
exemptions: combination, group and multi-piece packages (GSR 722(E), w.e.f. 01-01-2024)
alcoholic beverages/spirituous liquor - State Excise laws apply
rules.notes: Text says 'less than 1 kg' -> per gram and 'more than 1 kg' -> per kg; exactly 1 kg is not addressed in the current text. Earlier text used 'equal to or more than' for the per-kg/per-litre/per-metre unit. Suggest treating exactly 1 as per-kg/per-l/per-m (or configurable).

rules.title: Tiny packages (capacity <= 10 cm3): PDP may be a card or tape firmly affixed
rules.notes: Was '5 cubic cm' before GSR 385(E) of 14-05-2015.

rules.title: Minimum height of numerals and letters
rules.description: Height of any numeral and letter in the declarations must be at least the value from Table-I for the PDP area (use the 'blown/formed/molded' column where the information is blown, formed or molded on the container surface).
rules.notes: Rule 7(5): sub-rules (1)-(4) do not apply where the same info is required by another law, EXCEPT the size of numbers/letters for net weight, retail sale price, expiry/best-before/use-by date and consumer care details, which must still meet Table-I.

rules.title: Width of letter/numeral >= 1/3 of its height
rules.description: Exception: numeral '1' and letters 'i', 'I', 'l'.

rules.title: How PDP area is to be computed
rules.description: See calculations.pdp_area. Top, bottom, flanges of cans and shoulders/necks of bottles and jars are excluded.

rules.title: All declarations on the principal display panel
Clear space around the net quantity declaration
rules.description: Area around the quantity declaration must be free of printed information: above and below by at least the numeral height; left and right by at least twice the numeral height.

rules.title: Returnable soft-drink / RTS fruit-beverage bottles: RSP may be on crown cap or bottle
rules.notes: If RSP is on crown cap/bottle, the form 'MRP Rs..../₹.....' suffices.

rules.title: Declarations must be legible and prominent
rules.notes: Hand-written/hand-scripted declarations must be clear, unambiguous and legible.

rules.title: RSP and net quantity numerals in a colour contrasting with the background
rules.notes: Exempt where information is blown, formed or molded on a glass or plastic surface.

rules.title: No declaration that must be read through the liquid contents
Outer container/wrapper must repeat all declarations
rules.description: Unless the outer wrapper is transparent and the declarations on the package are easily readable through it. No declarations are needed on the inner package if the outer package contains all declarations.

rules.title: Declarations in Hindi (Devanagari) or English
rules.description: Any other language may be used in addition to Hindi or English.

rules.title: Name and complete address borne conspicuously on every package kept, offered or sold
rules.description: Name and complete address of the manufacturer; if manufacturer is not the packer, of both; for imported packages, of the importer.

rules.title: 'Complete address' definition
rules.description: Postal address at which the factory is situated or the company/firm is registered; in any other case: street name, number (if any) assigned to premises, city and State where business is carried on, and PIN code - so a consumer can identify and locate the manufacturer/packer/importer.

rules.title: Packages <= 10 cm3: a mark or inscription enabling identification of manufacturer/packer/importer is sufficient
Made outside India, packed in India: PDP must show name and complete address of Indian packer/importer
Actual corporate name (or business name if not incorporated)
Net quantity excludes wrappers and other materials
'When packed' not allowed where no significant variation due to environmental conditions
rules.description: Declared quantity must equal what the consumer receives. For commodities with only negligible variation, declaration must account for it so the consumer gets not less than declared; no 'when packed' qualifier.

rules.title: 'When packed' qualifier permitted only for Third Schedule commodities
Quantity expressed in the right kind of unit
rules.description: Mass for solid/semi-solid/viscous/solid-liquid mixtures; length if sold by linear measure; area if sold by area; volume if liquid or sold by cubic measure; number if sold by number. Exceptions in the Fourth Schedule.

rules.title: Optional additional count declaration when quantity is in mass
Add dimensions/number where weight/measure is not sufficient
Additional information about the commodity must be on the same panel as required declarations
No exaggerated, misleading or inadequate expression of quantity
rules.description: Words of any sort that create or are likely to create an exaggerated, misleading or inadequate impression of quantity are prohibited (earlier examples: minimum, not less than, average, about, approximately).

rules.title: Packages <= 10 cm3: quantity on a tag/card/tape bearing a mark identifying manufacturer/packer
Unit of weight/measure by magnitude
rules.description: See lookup_tables.units_by_magnitude. Fractions at or above the threshold are expressed as decimals of the larger unit (or in smaller units, e.g. 1.5 kg or 1 kg 500 g). Exactly one kg/m/m2/dm3/m3/l may be expressed in the smaller unit at the option of the manufacturer/packer/importer.

rules.title: No dozen, score, gross, great gross or the like
Only International System of Units (SI) permitted for net quantity
Items sold by number: state the number with 'number', 'unit', 'piece', 'pair', 'set' or similar word
rules.notes: 'L' may be used as the symbol for litre to avoid confusion with 'I' or '1' (Explanation, GSR 385(E)).

rules.title: Multiple packages of the same commodity inside a pre-package: supplementary declaration
rules.description: State number of packages and quantity of each (e.g. 10 number x 10 g for 100 g).

rules.title: Made-up textile items (bed-sheets, hemmed fabric, dhotis, sarees, napkins, pillow-covers, towels, table cloths, etc.)
rules.description: Declare number and finished-size dimensions. If the package contains pieces of different dimensions, declare dimensions and RSP of each piece; dimensions and sale price must also be marked on each individual piece.

rules.title: Where dimensions/weight relate to price, declaration of quantity must include them
Sheet-type commodities (aluminium foil, tissues, waxed paper, toilet paper, etc.)
rules.description: Declare number of usable sheets and dimensions of each sheet.

rules.title: Container-type commodities (bags, boxes, cups, pans, etc.)
rules.description: (i) bags: number of bags + linear dimensions; (ii) square/oblong/rectangular containers: number + length, width and (if required) depth; (iii) circular/round containers (not cups): number + diameter and (if necessary) depth; (iv) if label references relate to capacity to hold a standard weight/measure of a commodity, include that reference in the quantity declaration.

rules.title: Dealers/importers must not sell, distribute, deliver, display or store non-compliant packages
rules.description: Applies to wholesale dealer, retail dealer and importer. Wholesale dealers may sell pre-packaged commodities directly to industrial and institutional consumers (Rule 18(1A)).

rules.title: No sale above the retail sale price
No different MRPs on an identical pre-packaged commodity via restrictive/unfair trade practices
rules.description: Unless otherwise provided under another law, no manufacturer/packer/importer may declare different MRPs on an identical pre-packaged commodity by restrictive or unfair trade practices as defined in s.2(41) and s.2(47) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

rules.title: Tax revision after pre-packing
rules.description: Retail price cannot exceed the revised RSP communicated by the manufacturer/packer. The difference between marked and revised price must not exceed the tax increase (or fresh tax). Manufacturer/packer must advertise the revised prices in at least two newspaper advertisements and notify dealers and the Director/Controllers (newspaper publication not required for State-law tax changes). Revised prices apply only to packages pre-packed in the month of revision or the month after. If the revised price is LOWER, no price above the revised price may be charged irrespective of pre-pack month. Does not apply to packages not required to show month/year of pre-packing.

rules.title: No obliterating, smudging or altering the RSP marked by the manufacturer/packer/importer
Manufacturer/packer/importer must not alter price on a wrapper once printed and used for packing
Retailers under GST dealing in weight/volume packages must maintain a customer-check electronic weighing machine
rules.description: Accuracy class III, smallest division at least 1 g, able to print a receipt (gross quantity, price etc.), placed prominently, free of cost to consumers.

rules.title: LPG cylinders: check weigher and delivery-person weighing facility
rules.description: Marketing companies, manufacturers, packers, importers and distributors must keep a digital/analogue check weigher of Accuracy class III (Max 50 kg, e=10 g) and provide the delivery man with means to measure or weigh the cylinder.

rules.title: Deceptive packages
rules.description: A package that is designed to deliberately give an exaggerated or misleading impression of quantity is deceptive even if declared quantity is correct; it must be repacked/relabelled or is liable to seizure. Bigger dimensions are acceptable if justified as necessary for protection of the commodity or machine filling requirements.

rules.title: Wholesale package declarations
rules.description: Every wholesale package must bear a legible, definite, plain and conspicuous declaration of: (a) name and address of manufacturer or importer (or of the packer if the manufacturer/importer is not the packer); (b) identity of the commodity; (c) total number of retail packages in it OR net quantity in standard units of weight/measure/number. Not applicable where a similar declaration is required by other law.

rules.title: Export packages must not be sold in India unless re-packed/re-labelled per Chapter II
rules.consequence: Liable to seizure under the Act

rules.title: Registration of manufacturers, packers and importers
rules.description: Every individual, firm, HUF, society, company or corporation that pre-packs or imports any commodity for sale/distribution/delivery must apply to the Director/Controller (fee Rs. 500) within 90 days of commencing pre-packing/importing. Application contains: name; complete address of the premises; name of commodities pre-packed/imported. Alteration of certificate: fee Rs. 100. Incomplete applications are returned within 7 working days.

rules.title: A registered shorter address may be used on labels
Advertisements mentioning RSP must state net quantity/number in the same font size as the RSP

all_of: corrected average net quantity of sample >= declared net quantity
number of packages with deficiency error > MPE is <= value in column 4 of the Fifth Schedule table
no package has deficiency error > 2 x MPE
every package bears the required declarations

formulas.corrected_average: X_c = x_bar + (sigma * C), where C is the correction factor from the Fifth Schedule

triggers: number of packages exceeding MPE > column 4 limit
any package error in deficiency > 2 x MPE
actions: seize the sample packages and keep them safe until produced in court as evidence
initiate action under the Act and Rules
seized packages disposed per Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973
actions_on_non_compliance.rule_19_7_8: Mandatory declarations are ensured at factory level and at the depot of the factory. Action may be taken after seizing five representative samples; the rest may be released only after the manufacturer/packer completes compliance.

retail_wholesale_premises_testing.ordinarily_no_testing_unless: complaint received that a package was tampered with/pilfered/leaked or lacks declarations
retail_wholesale_premises_testing.deficiency_beyond_MPE: seize package and act against dealer; no punitive action against dealer if package carries 'when packed' and deficiency is proved to be due to environmental conditions
retail_wholesale_premises_testing.deficiency_within_MPE: dealer may sell at price based on quantity found on test

mpe_weight_volume_first_schedule_table_I.note: Applies to quantities declared by weight (g) or volume (ml). Each band gives EITHER a percentage of declared quantity OR an absolute value in g/ml. MPE applies in excess or in deficiency in the schedule; Rule 2(e) treats it as error in deficiency. Band boundaries as printed (e.g. 50, 100, 200) are shared between adjacent rows - treat lower bound as exclusive and upper bound as inclusive, and verify against the gazette.
mpe_weight_volume_first_schedule_table_I.rounding: Percentage-based MPE is rounded off to nearest 0.1 g/ml for declared quantity <= 1000 g/ml, and to the next whole g/ml for declared quantity > 1000 g/ml.

rows.mpe: 2% of declared quantity up to 10 m, and thereafter 1% of declared quantity
4% of declared quantity up to 10 sq. m, and thereafter 1% of declared quantity

mpe_length_area_number_first_schedule_ta.note: The source says 'thereafter 1%'; whether this applies to the whole quantity or only the excess over the threshold is not stated. Confirm with Legal Metrology authority before hard-coding.

sampling_notes: Samples selected at random from every lot; for stored lots, pick from top, bottom, centre, right, left, front and rear so the sample represents the lot.
For packages being filled, pick from already-filled packages, or feed marked tare-weighed empty containers into the packing line at random.

unit_sale_price_units.boundary_note: Current text says 'more than one' for the larger unit; superseded text said 'equal or more'. Exactly 1 kg/m/l is treated here as the larger unit.

units_by_magnitude.proviso: Where the quantity is exactly 1 kg / 1 m / 1 m2 / 1 dm3 / 1 m3 / 1 l it may be expressed in g / cm / dm2 / cm3 / dm3 / ml respectively at the option of manufacturer/packer/importer.

third_schedule_when_packed.description: Commodities sold by weight/volume whose quantity declaration may be qualified by 'When packed'

fourth_schedule_quantity_expression.description: Commodities that may be sold by weight, measure or number as shown (exceptions to Rule 12(2) default).

declared_in: weight and equivalent volume at stated temperature and pressure

rows.commodity: Edible oil, vanaspati, ghee and butter oil
rows.extra: If net quantity is declared by volume, it shall also be declared by weight

rows.commodity: Ice cream and other similar frozen products
rows.extra: 'Weight or volume' per GSR 426(E) of 05-06-2012 / GSR 722(E)

rows.commodity: Paints other than paste/solid paint; varnish; varnish stains; enamels
Rasgulla, Gulabjamun and other sweet preparations
Cosmetics including creams, shampoo, lotions and perfumes

second_schedule_standard_pack_sizes.note: Rule 5 and the Second Schedule (standard pack sizes for baby food, biscuits, tea, coffee, edible oils, soaps, aerated drinks, packaged drinking water, cement, paints, etc.) were omitted w.e.f. 01-01-2024. Do not enforce.

excludes: flange at top and bottom of cans
shoulders and neck of bottles and jars

methods.condition: one entire side can properly be treated as the PDP
methods.formula: height x width of that side
0.40 x total surface area of the package, or the area considered to be the PDP

maximum_permissible_error.weight_volume: Look up band in lookup_tables.mpe_weight_volume_first_schedule_table_I; if mpe_percent: MPE = declared * percent / 100, rounded per rounding rule; else MPE = absolute value.

calculations.lot_level: Use inspection_and_quantity_testing.lot_approval_criteria with the Fifth Schedule plan.

tare_weight_procedure_sixth_schedule.if_tare_weight_le_0_3_x_MPE: Use single tare for all samples.
tare_weight_procedure_sixth_schedule.else: Weigh 5 tare packages; if (max tare - min tare) <= 0.4 x MPE use the mean tare; otherwise open and weigh every sampled package (Sixth Schedule para 3(4)) or use marked empty containers fed through the packing line (para 3(5)).
tare_weight_procedure_sixth_schedule.liquids_by_volume: If specific gravity is sufficiently constant, use weight method; otherwise pour contents into a suitable volume measure (para 4).

rule_32_general.text: Whoever contravenes any provision of these Rules for which no punishment is provided shall be punished with fine of Rs. 5,000

amounts_inr.offence: Contravention of section 29 of the Act
Contravention of section 36(1) of the Act
Contravention of section 36(2) of the Act

penalties.rule_33_relaxation: Central Government may, after ascertaining genuineness, permit a manufacturer/packer to pack for sale for a reasonable period by relaxing one or more provisions with corrective measures.

transitional_note.no_prosecution_clause: Per GSR 779(E) dated 02-11-2021 and its extensions up to GSR 714(E) dated 30-09-2023 (valid till 01-01-2024), no prosecution was to be initiated for declarations made under the amended Rules (changes to Rule 2(aa), 4, 5, 6(1)(d), 6(1)(e), 6(11), 13(5)(ii), 18(2A), 18(7)). That relief period has lapsed as of 01-01-2024.
